sermon.title: Let Both Grow Together -- July 11, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer goes back to the beginning to show that God let the good and bad seed grow together from Eden to the flood: Cain’s line and Seth’s line, with no law, God as judge, and millions growing worse while Noah walked with God. Sin was not imputed without law, Christ died to bring us to God, and the same water that destroyed the wicked saved the righteous.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message begins at 26:40 after worship. He notes on his chart that he listed Jabal twice.

faqs.question: How did Eve sin?
faqs.answer: She broke the one rule and, he says, proselytized Adam; sinners like support.

faqs.question: Was Adam the son of God like Jesus?
faqs.answer: No; Adam was created, as we are created new; Jesus was born of a virgin.

faqs.question: When did Methuselah die?
faqs.answer: The same year the flood came.

faqs.question: What is the speeding illustration?
faqs.answer: If no law says how fast to go, you’re innocent.

faqs.question: What does he say about Mohammed?
faqs.answer: He calls the teaching that Jesus did not die “very dumb.”

faqs.question: Do we need a priest to come to God?
faqs.answer: No; the veil was torn and all can come as individuals.
